title: China's Unitree unveils 'Superman' robot as fervour builds ahead of Shanghai debut
excerpt: China's Unitree unveiled a new high-speed robot it dubbed "Superman" on Monday, days before becoming ‌the first general-purpose robotics company to list on m...
content_html:
By Samuel Shen and Eduardo Baptista

SHANGHAI/BEIJING, Aug 17 (Reuters) - China's Unitree unveiled a new high-speed robot it dubbed "Superman" on Monday, days before becoming ‌the first general-purpose robotics company to list on mainland China's stock ‌market.

Unitree, the world's biggest humanoid-robot maker by sales, will start trading in Shanghai on Wednesday after ​raising 6.1 billion yuan ($905 million) in an initial public offering last week.

The company, based in the eastern Chinese tech hub of Hangzhou, said it developed the new robot in just over three months. It achieved a standing jump of 2 metres ‌and reached a top speed ⁠of 12.66 metres per second.

The Shanghai debut coincides with the opening of the World Robot Conference in Beijing, adding to ⁠investor attention on a company whose humanoid robots have drawn global notice for running, dancing and performing martial arts.

The IPO was more than 8,000 times oversubscribed by retail ​investors, a ​record for Shanghai's tech-focused STAR Market.

In a ​social-media post last week, Unitree ‌said it had cumulatively produced and delivered about 18,000 bipedal humanoid robots across multiple models as of July.

DERIVATIVES MARKET POINTS TO STRONG DEBUT

Unitree said the robot remained a work in progress and could be improved further in coming months.

Founder Wang Xingxing gained national prominence after securing a front-row seat at a summit hosted ‌by Chinese President Xi Jinping for leading ​technology entrepreneurs last year.

The startup is also backed ​by some of China's most influential ​technology companies including Tencent, Alibaba, and DeepSeek.

Ahead of Unitree's Shanghai ‌listing, derivative trading in offshore markets ​has pointed to a ​strong debut.

Its shares may also benefit from a broader recovery in Chinese technology stocks following last month's selloff.

The STAR50 Index has rebounded about 15% ​from a three-month low ‌hit in early August.

($1 = 6.7382 Chinese yuan renminbi)

(Reporting by Samuel Shen ​in Shanghai, Shi Bu, Yukun Zhang and Eduardo Baptista in Beijing. ​Editing by Kirsten Donovan and Mark Potter)

content_html_zh:
作者：塞缪尔·沉和爱德华多·巴普蒂斯塔

路透上海/北京 8 月 17 日 - 中国 Unitree 周一推出了一款名为“超人”的新型高速机器人，几天后成为第一家在中国大陆股市上市的通用机器人公司。

按销售额计算，全球最大的仿人机器人制造商 Unitree 将于周三在上海开始交易，上周在首次公开募股中筹集了 61 亿元人民币（9.05 亿美元）。

该公司总部位于中国东部科技中心杭州，表示它在短短三个多月的时间内开发出了这款新机器人。 它实现了 2 米的立定跳跃，最高速度达到每秒 12.66 米。

在上海的首次亮相恰逢世界机器人大会在北京开幕，这增加了投资者对这家公司的关注，该公司的人形机器人因跑步、跳舞和表演武术而受到全球关注。

此次 IPO 获得散户投资者超额认购 8,000 倍以上，创下上海科技科创板市场的纪录。

Unitree 在上周的社交媒体帖子中表示，截至 7 月，该公司已累计生产并交付了约 18,000 个多种型号的双足人形机器人。

衍生品市场强势亮相

Unitree 表示，该机器人仍在开发中，可能在未来几个月内进一步改进。

去年，创始人王星星在中国国家主席习近平主办的领先科技企业家峰会上获得前排席位后，获得了全国知名度。

该初创公司还得到了一些中国最具影响力的科技公司的支持，包括腾讯、阿里巴巴和 DeepSeek。

在Unitree上海上市之前，离岸市场的衍生品交易表现强劲。

其股价也可能受益于中国科技股继上个月抛售后的更广泛复苏。

STAR50 指数已从 8 月初触及的三个月低点反弹约 15%。

($1 = 6.7382 Chinese yuan renminbi)

（Samuel Shen 在上海报道，Shi Bu、Yukun 张和 Eduardo Baptista 在北京报道。​Kirsten Donovan 和 Mark Potter 编辑）
